nodes.speaker: Historian
nodes.text: Ah, a visitor! Welcome to the About House. This is where we keep the story of how this place came to be.

nodes.speaker: Historian
text: Andres Villegas — a full-stack developer who wanted his portfolio to be more than a list of links.
He thought: what if visitors could explore projects like rooms in a world? Walk up to a building, step inside, and actually use the app. So he built this.

nodes.speaker: Historian
text: The game engine is Phaser 3, wrapped in Angular 19. The backend is Express with MongoDB. Everything runs on a single Raspberry Pi 4.
8 gigs of RAM, a 235GB drive, and a Wi-Fi connection. That tiny computer serves every app, every NPC, every pixel you see.

nodes.speaker: Historian
nodes.text: Take your time with the bookshelves. Each one holds a chapter of the project's history. Lots of late nights in those pages.

nodes.speaker: Historian
nodes.text: Press ESC to head back outside. Thanks for taking the time to learn about this place!
